| `links[].url` | str | required | The address to open; a question to someone else needs one the recipient can open. |
| `project` | str \| None | `None` | Project id, if the question is about one. |
| `kind` | Literal['question', 'decision'] | `'question'` | question: an ordinary question. decision: a choice for the PM to make. |

### `question.done`

Record the answer to an open question and close it. Also records the answer as a fact. Refused if the question doesn't exist or is already closed; evidence is required.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the open question that was answered. |
| `answer` | str | required | The answer, in words. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `record.delete`

Delete a record. Refused while another live record refers to it, or if it changed since it was read; Undo brings it back. A system op: from the assistant it waits for the person; never part of extracting notes.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `record` | RecordRef | required | The record to delete. |
| `record.kind` | str | required | The record kind, such as project or a plugin's own kind. |
| `record.id` | str | required | The record's id. |
| `read_version` | int | required | The version of the record that was read; the delete fails if it changed. |

### `record.edit`

The person's own change to fields of any record (core or a plugin's), such as an edit made to the record's file in the synced folder: it waits for the person's review there, and applies as theirs. Long text, the stage, the id and plugin extension fields aren't changed this way. Only the person uses it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `record` | RecordRef | required | The record to change. |
| `record.kind` | str | required | The record kind, such as project or a plugin's own kind. |
| `record.id` | str | required | The record's id. |
| `fields` | dict[str, Any] | required | The new values, by field name. |
| `read_version` | int | required | The record's version the edit was made from. |

### `record.log`

Add a dated line to a project's update log. The line is dated the day it is applied.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `project` | str | required | The id of the project whose log gets the line. |
| `text` | str | required | The line to add. |

### `record.set`

Change one field of an existing record. Allowed fields: project status, phase, target, priority, summary, parent (the id of the project it belongs to), language (a tag such as en-US) and owner (a person's id); action text, due and notes; question title and text; person role, org and why_they_matter. The new value must be valid for the field. Evidence is required for due, status, owners, target and owner.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `kind` | Literal['project', 'action', 'question', 'person'] | required | The kind of record to change. |
| `id` | str | required | The id of the record to change. |
| `field` | str | required | The field to set; only the fields listed for this kind are allowed. |
| `value` | Any | required | The new value, in the field's own type; a date is written YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `evidence` | EvidenceIn \| None | see below | The words that justify the change; see the fields needing it. |
| `evidence.quote` | str | required | The exact words from the input that justify this op. |

### `stage.move`

Propose entering a configured stage. Always waits for the person's confirmation.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `record` | RecordRef | required | The record to move. |
| `record.kind` | str | required | The record kind, such as project or a plugin's own kind. |
| `record.id` | str | required | The record's id. |
| `to` | str | required | The id of the stage to enter. |
| `read_version` | int | required | The version of the record that was read; the move fails if it changed. |

### `text.accept`

Accept a pending version, change by change: the result becomes the field's text, with authorship following the choices. Changes not listed are accepted; rejecting every change discards it. Only the person uses it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `version` | str | required | The id of the pending text version. |
| `read_version` | int | required | The version of that record that was reviewed. |
| `choices` | dict[str, Literal['accept', 'reject']] | `{}` | Per change id (c1, c2, ...): accept or reject. |

### `text.discard`

Set a pending version aside without changing the field. Only the person uses it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `version` | str | required | The id of the pending text version. |
| `read_version` | int | required | The version of that record that was reviewed. |

### `text.draft`

The assistant's draft for a long text field, made by the core from a draft task's prose answer: a pending version for the person's review, never the field's text until accepted. Draft tasks only.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `record` | RecordRef | required | The record whose field it is. |
| `record.kind` | str | required | The record kind, such as project or a plugin's own kind. |
| `record.id` | str | required | The record's id. |
| `field` | str | required | The long text field. |
| `text` | str | required | The whole drafted text. |
| `base` | int \| None | `None` | The number of the version it was made from. |
| `run` | str \| None | `None` | The AI run that wrote it. |
| `paragraph_map` | list[dict[str, Any]] | `[]` | For an anchored draft, per paragraph in order, the base units it came from: {from: [p1, ...]}. |
| `questions` | list[str] | `[]` | Questions for the person the draft ended with, shown beside it. |

### `text.edit`

The person's own new text for a long text field, written here: it becomes the field's text at once, with the person as author of every passage it changes. Only the person (an edit on screen or their own action) uses it.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `record` | RecordRef | required | The record whose field it is. |
| `record.kind` | str | required | The record kind, such as project or a plugin's own kind. |
| `record.id` | str | required | The record's id. |
| `field` | str | required | The long text field. |
| `text` | str | required | The whole new text. |

### `text.propose`

The person's own work on a long text field arriving from outside (a working copy handed back, a file edited elsewhere): a pending version for review, made from version `base` (the current one if unset).

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `group` | str \| None | `None` | Ops that must be undone together share a group name. |
| `record` | RecordRef | required | The record whose field it is. |
| `record.kind` | str | required | The record kind, such as project or a plugin's own kind. |
| `record.id` | str | required | The record's id. |
| `field` | str | required | The long text field. |
| `text` | str | required | The whole proposed text. |
| `base` | int \| None | `None` | The number of the version it was made from. |
| `note` | str \| None | `None` | Where it came from, for the review. |
| `unmapped` | list[str] | `[]` | What couldn't be mapped back into the text, shown beside the proposal. |
